text: “That was a wrong thing for you to say, that you would have had nothing to try for. If we had lost our own chief good, other people’s good would remain, and that is worth trying for. Some can be happy. I seemed to see that more clearly than ever, when I was the most wretched. I can hardly think how I could have borne the trouble, if that feeling had not come to me to make strength.” “You have never felt the sort of misery I felt,” said Will; “the misery of knowing that you must despise me.” “But I have felt worse—it was worse to think ill—” Dorothea had begun impetuously, but broke off.
